field_acceptance: Install the authorized internal TestFlight build and sign in with normal ACP credentials.
Confirm Company and MAIN Branch authority, then open My Day.
Open an assigned Job and verify Customer, service location, schedule, and service category.
Open Directions and, when separately authorized, verify the assignment-scoped Customer contact.
Clock In and confirm the server-backed active state and elapsed display.
Use On My Way, Arrived, Start Work, Pause, and Resume only where the server offers each action.
Record work performed and customer disposition; refresh and confirm persisted evidence.
Review equipment, service evidence, issued Estimate, active Price Book, Invoice, payment, and communication status only where permissions expose them.
Complete Work only when ACP reports completion readiness, then refresh Invoice handoff.
Clock Out and confirm a distinct stop event, completed Job interval, current-period entry, and office-visible evidence.
Interrupt connectivity, verify stale labels and disabled mutations, reconnect, and confirm authoritative reconciliation without duplicate action.
Sign out, verify protected state is cleared, sign back in, and confirm current authority is re-resolved.
